Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['Final Fantasy XIII-2: The story so far...', "(auto-talk) Alyssa Zaidelle. I'm an Academy intern. I heard you apprehended our two observers, so here I am...", "Hmm. I'll supply you both with comm devices. Right this way, please.", "Oh, no. Sorry about all of that 'observer' nonsense back there. Lucky for us, that soldier was so quick to believe me.", "(giggles) I told you, that was a cover. I'm just a trainee looking to make it big.", '(auto-talk) Right this way, please!', "You'll need an ID to travel any further into the ruins. Here, take this communicator and keep it with you at all times.", 'Yeah?', '(points at him) I saw you two. I saw how you got here through that thing.', "Yes, it is a kind of gate. It links to another world, doesn't it?", 'Nice to finally have some clue what these things are for.', 'I do have questions, yes. About the gate, and about the paradox.', 'You will? Great!', "You know what I heard? They might be shutting this site down pretty soon. It's all because of Atlas. It's too unsafe with him around. But... but there's still so much I want to explore.", "Here's hoping Atlas stops moving. Then we can get to the bottom of this whole paradox business.", "It's not easy, though, with all these things they keep throwing at me. I'm still a trainee. I mean, I've got my exam to prepare for.", "I'd heard your name before, you know. There are some people who haven't forgotten what the l'Cie started on Cocoon, Serah Farron.", "I don't suppose you've learned anything about Atlas.", 'If you notice anything suspicious, let us know.', "(auto-talk, over communicator) We're sifting through the ruins to see what hidden technologies we can dig up. Since the fal'Cie lost their power, human science is all we have left to rely on.", '(over communicator) Serah... you should take this more seriously.', "(auto-talk, over communicator) There used to be a cemetery in the ruins. But now it's gone... If you come across any gravestones, let me know. It's driving me crazy!", "(over communicator) We've detected a large energy surge in the center of the ruins. Another unknown device has appeared.", "(auto-talk, over communicator) If a gate leads to another reality, does that mean there's another 'me' somewhere in that world? I think about it sometimes. I mean, maybe I don't really exist and I'm just a character in the 'real' me's dream. And if that's true, then I'd better make the most of it before I wake up!", "(over communicator) Well, no one can say for sure. It's like they'd always been there, and one day we finally noticed.", "(over communicator) Uh... Noel? I'm not sure I can tell if you're being serious or not...", "(auto-talk, over communicator) I think there might be a cemetery somewhere in the ruins. Please tell me if you think you've find it.", "(auto-talk, over communicator) There's something I just have to make sure of. They can't seal off the ruins. Not yet. They still deal with threats the same way. The government didn't learn anything from the Purge.", '(auto-talk, over communicator) Ugh, finally! Can you hear me now? It looks like Atlas is starting to slow down a little.', "(auto-talk, over communicator) Some say that time is a box full of possibilities. Until someone from the future peeks inside, the past remains uncertain. You know what I think? Maybe we're just one of those possibilities, waiting for the box to be opened. And I think this paradox phenomenon is happening because someone in the distant future can't decide whether or not to flip the lid.", "That's great news! I'm on my way!", "(approaching) This is it! This is the place! (She sinks to the ground and reaches her hand towards the epitaph.) I thought it might be... But that's not my name.", "It's my friend's. She died here. Running from the Purge. (gets up) And me? I'm one of those who survived. Five years ago, the entire town of Bodhum-- it was wiped out by the army. I was there, visiting my friend. Then everything went to hell. We ran and hid with the other fugitives. But just as the troops were pulling out... That's when the ceiling of our hiding place collapsed. Ever since then, I've had the same dream. I'm trapped under rubble. It's dark, I'm in pain, and I can barely breathe. The next thing I know, I rise out of my body, and I'm standing before this grave. (points) And the name written on the stone... It's mine. After seeing that image so many times, I started to think that maybe I did die back then. And the life I'm living now is just an illusion.", '(chuckles) Real enough, I guess. (She sits down to look at the stone again.) Even if they all forget... I never will.', "Thank you. You've helped me see that I can overcome any experience, no matter how terrible.", "Forgive me. I was just so glad it wasn't my name on there. I wish it wasn't yours either...", '(suddenly running up, breathing heavily) Director Hope! There you are! What were you thinking? Taking off and leaving me all on my own.', "How long has it been? Five years? You two haven't changed at all.", 'Ruins are places where memories gather like dust. So many layers of time... Probably the easiest place for a paradox to occur.', "We've made significant progress these past five years.", 'This is the front line of paradox research.', 'This eclipse is so unusual.', "I'd say the institution has grown considerably since the last time we met.", "Without the fal'Cie around, we have to be able to protect ourselves. And that means guns.", "You know, I wish you'd said where and when you were from the last time we met.", 'The whole place was in an uproar after you suddenly disappeared.', "I'm so glad Mog is still with you. I like him.", 'No, they were destroyed because they could see the future.', "Being able to see the future is awfully dangerous. It can mess with people's heads.", "Oh! Come on, Director Hope! I want to show them! It's okay to show them, isn't it?", "I think I'm a bit jealous of you, Serah. You can travel to the past or the future, and if you find somewhere you like, you can just stay there.", 'Well, of course you are.', 'Oh, hi. Still wandering around the ruins?', '(auto-talk) Director! Who are you waiting for?', 'Director!', 'What happened? Did the prophecy get rewritten?', 'When is Cocoon supposed to fall? How many years? Is it soon?', "(looks relieved) Oh, that's a long time from now. I mean, none of us'll even be alive to see it.", 'Yeah, but how? You think you can go to the time when it falls and hold it up yourselves? Do you even have a gate to take you there?', "I still find it hard to believe though, that my memories can change just like that. - We've got work to do. - Long time, no see. But not really. Strange, huh?", "With paradoxes, anything's possible. 'Until someone from the future peeks inside time, the past remains uncertain.' Do you remember talking about that? Paradoxes are spacetime entanglements, differing possibilities sealed in a box. When an observer peers into the future and corrects its contradictions, possible past histories collapse into a single timeline.", 'You got it. And it works the other way, too. Twist the future, and the whole of spacetime, backwards and forwards, gets bent out of shape.', "I'm in pain, and I can barely breathe.", '(tosses off a wave) Later!', "We realized we couldn't let that happen. We had to levitate Cocoon using only human technology.", "So I bet you're dying to know how we came to the future, huh?", "You've heard about the time capsule we used? It's a device that slows down time only for its occupants. The effect is caused by the creation of a powerful gravitational field and... well, essentially we just slept as the outside world flashed forward into the future.", "Unfortunately not. And considering it broke down after a single use... I doubt it'll prove to be a popular method of time travel.", 'Oh, the director was there with me. Hey, Serah? After coming to the future myself, I-I think I understand how you must feel. The Academy has welcomed us with open arms, and we can research as we always have, but... ... sometimes I get these terrible anxiety attacks.', "Please, Serah, you have to let me apologize for the way I treated you in the past. Maybe you can't forgive me for that, but I hope as fellow time travelers we can face the future on friendly terms.", 'The Academy has made progress on its investigation into the Thirteenth Ark. At this stage, there is good news and there is bad news.', "We've discovered that the Ark's reactor is powered by an ore cluster known as the Graviton Core. By collecting these, there's a possibility that the new Cocoon will be up in the sky in no time!", "I'll put together some data on Graviton Cores. Check in with the Academy front desk.", 'Thanks to you two, we almost have all the cores we need!', 'Did I tell you? The director is inventing a new device.', "But, Director? Didn't you say you were missing a certain material?", "You've brought us another cluster!? Thank you so much. I mean it.", "He's right, you know.", 'Yes, I think so. And look what I found. It was lying next to the gate.', "That's what we figured. Thought we'd save you the trip.", "Sometimes, when it looks like all hope is lost, people can turn against each other. They end up full of hate. But really, when they stop and think about it, they're making themselves sad for no reason. Director? What are you looking at me like that for?", "That was always in the back of your mind, wasn't it, Director? If we abandoned the old Cocoon, maybe you could free your friends. Or am I wrong? It's okay. We all knew. We wanted to help anyway.", "(voice) I'm sorry. But in the new future that you wish to build, I no longer exist. Good-bye.", 'Yes, I think so. And look what I found. It was lying next to the gate.', 'Huh? What?', '(grabs for the artefact, but is restrained) Give that back!', 'So what if he did?', '(Alyssa-entity) Nice to meet you.', 'A fabricated life-form... or a living machine, the semantics are irrelevant.', 'Yes, everyone is a duplicate. An artificial life-form.', 'The Caius entity came through recently, accompanied by a green-eyed girl. They were proceeding to the top of the tower.', 'Of course. This way.', 'This way, please.', 'This was an effect of the paradox. You just witnessed an event that took place on this spot 187 years ago.', "Yes. After the tower was completed. During the Proto fal'Cie development project, the artificial intelligence and humans came into conflict.", "You two have seen it now. You've seen the forbidden history. People who know too much have to be buried."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Greetings, young man and young lady! How would you like to test your knowledge with Captain Cryptic's Confounding Quiz!?", 'I am Captain Cryptic, quiz-giver extraordinaire! So, little lady, how about that quiz?', "Correct! Captain Cryptic is a quiz-centric duplicate. Let's get started then!", 'Mommy not helping with your homework?', "And we're still on the easy questions! Oh, boy.", 'Exercise that gray matter! And away we go! Question time!', 'Yes! This round is yours!', "And we're still on the easy questions! Oh, boy.", 'Show me how brawny your brains have become! And away we go! Question time!', 'Oho, well done!', "That's showing your smarts!", "Welcome to Captain Cryptic's Confounding Quiz! And away we go! Question time!", 'Excellent. Another winning answer.', "And we're still on the easy questions! Oh, boy.", 'Are we ready, my little lad and lass? And away we go! Question time!', 'Yes! This round is yours!', "Welcome to Captain Cryptic's Confounding Quiz! And away we go! Question time!", 'I am Captain Cryptic, quiz-giver extraordinaire!', 'No more questions for you two!', 'Quiz time is over now, kiddies!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['(deep voice) Who dares? Explain this intrusion!', 'Travels of the Void Beyond. What are you seeking in this bloodstained place of war?', 'My domain exists outside the march of ages. It is unseen and unknown, beyond life and death. Until the day the bell of the goddess tolls, this realm welcomes not the living. Begone from here. You bring naught but calamity. My halls already play host to an omen of time-shattering misfortune.', '(lighting up with energy and posing) Begone, I say! Heed my words... Or face judgment at my hands!', '(lighting up again) Take it, and leave this place! (He produces a fragment.) The Day of Reckoning has not yet come.', 'I am the Arbiter of Time. I am the lord of this domain. This field exists only for battle and death.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['What... what happened?', "The airship went up in flames. I don't know if the others survived. But I do remember one thing-after the crash, I saw that our pilot, Ray, was still breathing. He must have wandered off somewhere.", 'The situation is just hopeless.', 'I pray that everyone else is safe and sound.', "I'm all right, I swear. I'm just worried about the others.", 'Would you mind looking for my friends? I know this area is dangerous, but it would mean a great deal to me.', 'Please. Find the pilot that crashed in the vicinity. We call him Ray.', "We're not authorized to share personal information so we use call signs. Our commander's name is Sergeant Blitz.", "There's not an inch of me that doesn't hurt. But don't worry, I am not gonna die here--not now.", "Please, check on the others. I'm fine. I'll wait here for the evac team.", "You want to know where it hurts? How's 'everywhere' for an answer?", "Oh, thank goodness! Ray, the guys... They're okay!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['I think you guys took a wrong turn somewhere. The kiddie pool is that way!', 'This medical textbook is useless. It has no appendix!', "The book of magic was useless. They didn't run a spell check!", "Not all jokes are funny. I'm proof of that!", "You're Mog nificient. I've met my Serah people and I Noel not many can keep up! You have my respect! Now give it back! I wrote everything down. Here, take this. Oh, and one other thing--tell him he's my one and only buddy till the day I stop breathing. You look confused. See, the thing is, the man you talked to before, my buddy, he died three years ago. I don't mean to scare ya, but you were talking to a ghost, not a person. Thanks for playing along! I had a roaring good time!", "You're still here? Are you looking for something? Like your dignity?", "When you see my buddy, tell him I'll see him around. Wait, scratch that--I can't!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["You two are famous. People say you're quite the swordsmen. Do you care to prove that you're as good as they say? I recently received an urgent request from one of the labs at the Academy. They need a fang from a behemoth as soon as possible for a project they're working on. They don't want just any fang, though. They need one that's in pristine condition. Unfortunately, with the military's current weapons... ... there's no possible way to take down a monster that size without ruining its fang in the process. Now that you know the situation, if you happen to come across any, would you mind sharing them with me? I know it's a lot to ask, but it would help me out so much.", 'If you change your mind, please let me know.', "The Academy's scientists are looking for a certain body part belonging to a behemoth.", "I'm trying to get my hands on the fang of a behemoth. I haven't come across any in good enough condition.", "Thank you! I appreciate this. If you're as good as they say, this should be easy. Once the Academy gets their hands on an adequate sample, they're going to use it to research all sorts of things... ... such as the monster's biology and evolutionary background.", "A behemoth fang! And it's in such good condition! I can't believe you managed to get this! So the rumors were true. You two are nothing less than excellent! The Academy scientists will be thrilled! Once the lab gets ahold of this, they'll be able to figure out everything they need to know about the monster, like where it comes from. Did the paradox bring this beast from the past or from the future? Is it the creation of the fal'Cie, humans, or Mother Nature? What you brought us will give us the answer we've been searching for. I want to thank for helping me out of this predicament. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.", "(auto-talk) I've never heard of just two people defeating a behemoth. That's incredible. The military uses brute force, but a little magic goes a long way.", "(auto-talk) I want to thank you for finding something that's so important to me. I hope my research will help build a bright future for everyone."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["See this flower? Isn't it the most beautiful thing you've ever seen? It's called the Flower of Fenrir. It only bears fruit once every couple hundred years, during the time of the eclipse. Unlike most flowers, it requires complete darkness to go through the process of bearing fruit. It's an amazing subject to research, but... As you can see, at this stage, it's still a flower. I don't know exactly how long it'll take or when it'll produce fruit... ..but I do know that it's unlikely that it'll happen in my lifetime. But I can still hope, can't I?", "I know it's impossible. But it doesn't hurt to dream, does it?", 'I wish I could find out what sort of fruit this flower will bear.', "If only I could see the flower's fruit with my own eyes during my lifetime.", "Really? You're willing to search for the Fruit of Fenrir for me? I don't think it's possible to find one when there's no eclipse. Or do you know something I don't? Is there a secret way to obtain one?", "You say you've found something that resembles the fruit? But... how can that be? This is it... I can't believe my eyes! I don't know how you did it, but you found one! Thank you so much! Now I can focus on the research I've always wanted to do. I can finally figure out how this fruit is able to grow in complete darkness. Ever since the fal'Cie became dormant, the weather on Cocoon has been pretty miserable. There are always dark clouds in the sky. I want to engineer a plant that will help cheer people up. I know many people have abandoned Cocoon. But I want to show people that no matter how grim things might be, there's always hope. Just like this flower can bear fruit without light."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['This eternity--it was never your desire. Is that not so, Yeul?', "Warrior goddess. (He draws a sword which features a large glowing orb of energy.) Now we cross swords. (Lightning draws her own gunblade with a flash of feathers. Caius slashes his sword and leaps into the air. A fight begins between Caius's and Lightning's monsters.) Lose yourself in battle, and rejoice!", '(chuckles and sends out another beam of energy) Husk of the wandering comet... I summon thee!', 'Impressive.', "Let's not waste time.", 'The goddess made a wise choice. Powers of chaos, bend to my will!', 'Keeping up?', 'Oblivion is the fate of all things.', 'Predictable.', "Now it's my turn.", 'Pathetic.', 'I long since ceased to feel pain!', 'Final Fantasy XIII-2: The story so far...', 'If you change the future, you change the past.', 'You must understand. There are many Yeuls.', 'I learned of journey, leaping back and forth along the timeline. Yeul has been watching everything you do.', 'Yes. I see you understand the significance of that. Then you must also understand that I am here for a reason. Your actions have necessitated the strongest sanctions.', 'I must protect the sanctity of the timeline.', 'Face your worst fear.', 'Times have changed. I am not the Caius you once knew. (He levels his sword at Noel.) To change history is a sin.', "(kneeling at Yeul's feet) But, must we accept this, Yeul?", '(voices echoing in flashback) If you change the future, you change the past.', 'Yeul...', 'Yeul. Will you allow this?', 'Will they ever find the dawn?', "Pretend to capitulate and buy yourself time. It's not a bad strategy.", '(points) Wrong. You are the enemy. You are contradictions in the timeline. I have every reason to eliminate you. Two hundred years ago, you learned the forbidden history, and were entombed in that tower as a consequence. But now you stand before me, alive and well once again. What can that be, if not a paradox?', 'There is no mistake. You are one and the same. A distortion. A contradiction.', 'Your very existence poisons the timeline and invites disaster.', 'Vermin. If this tragedy is to come to an end, no trace of you can remain in this reality.', '(voiceover, flashback) Two hundred years ago, you learned the forbidden history and were entombed in that tower as a consequence.', '(voice, flashback) Two hundred years ago, you learned the forbidden history and were entombed in that tower as a consequence. But now you stand before me, alive and well once again. What can that be, if not a paradox?', 'I shall remember your pain. It will be carved in my heart. Together with the memories of every other Yeul, cursed to die this way.', 'I shall remember your pain.', 'To live is without meaning.', "You fight bravely. (She charges at him, but he vanishes and reappears behind her. She slashes again, but it's no go. Caius reappears on the throne.) Noel gave up much more quickly than this.", "To save her. Long ago, the goddess Etro rescued you and your friends from your fate as l'Cie. For you, it was a miracle. For Yeul, a sentence of death. In that moment, immutable history was transformed. Time was twisted. With each distortion of the future, the life of the seeress was cut short. (He has a flash of one of Yeul's deaths.) So often have I seen this... Seen her wilt before my eyes. When time is in flux, the future changes, and Yeul is consumed. So I will dam the river of time... ... and tear down the foundations of history. Only then will Yeul's suffering come to an end.", "Surrender now to your heart's desire.", 'Did you get one?', "You're improving. It must have been a difficult hunt.", '(chuckles) Yes, you are ready to become the one true Guardian.', 'Because, Noel, that is the way. You are ready to challenge me to a duel. If you defeat me, the sacred pact passes to you. Just as I once defeated my predecessor.', 'I killed him. That is the law of the Guardians. There can only be one. Noel. If you wish to succeed me... You must kill me.', 'Well? Are you ready to kill me?', 'Leave and go where?', 'That is a vain hope, and you of all people should know it.', 'There is one thing. Kill me.', 'The Heart of Chaos beats in my chest-- a manifestation of Etro. Should this heart stop beating, the goddess will die once again. When the goddess dies, the chaos of Valhalla is unleashed. The chaos has the power to warp the timeline and destroy the past.', 'If you cannot... ... you must die instead.', 'To live is without meaning.', 'Face your worst fear.', "It's as I feared. You are too weak.", "Surrender now to your heart's desire.", "You still don't know the truth, Serah. You are the same as Yeul. You can see the timeline. Even if you save your future, you will not survive to see it.", 'How very noble of you. But you shall die first!', 'Face your worst fear.', 'You fight bravely to protect your friends. Like a true Guardian.', 'Everything I do is for Yeul. Her spirit is bound by a curse. I will save her.', 'Here in Valhalla, the chaos is my ally. Now let us decide the true history!', 'You both shall know despair.', 'You cannot kill me. Not now.', "Which Yeul are you talking about? I've known and protected hundreds of Yeuls. Although they had the same soul, every one of them was unique. A Yeul who dreamed of travel! A Yeul who loved to sing! A Yeul who collected flowers. They all died. All of them, before my eyes!", "Noel, you told me that Yeul is reborn because of me. Then I have to die. We must free Yeul. Kill me. You're the only one that can end this eternal torment.", 'Lightning is dead. I killed her with my own hands. Will you allow me to go unpunished?', '(chuckles) In Valhalla, time does not flow as it should. Long before we began our battle here, I had already faced her. Now she sleeps, never to wake. Things that shall happen in your future have already been decided... in my own past. I know how it begins, and how it ends.', 'The moment I cease to exist, Yeul shall be released from her fate.', 'Impressive. (He grabs the sword.) He who can change time, must choose between those who die, and those who live. You must bear the burden. Of the eternal paradox!', 'The Heart of Chaos beats in my chest, a manifestation of Etro. Should this heart stop beating, the goddess will die once again.', 'When the goddess dies, the chaos of Valhalla is unleashed. The chaos has the power to warp the timeline and destroy the past.', 'Every one them was unique! They all died.', 'To live is without meaning.', 'To live is without meaning.', 'There must be some temporal distortion.', 'This is the world you chose. Had you simply accepted defeat, a pleasant dream would have been yours for all eternity.', 'Face your worst fear.', 'There must be some temporal distortion.', '(narrating against a black screen) They have seen all of history, all of its possibilities. They have seen all the endings.', 'But they must know, the goddess Etro is already dead.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['Welcome to our timeless paradise, Serendipity! You guys are travelers lost in time, right? Is this your first time here?', "All sorts of people come here for different reasons. Don't worry--we won't try to get in the way of you having fun. In this place, we're all just servants of the goddess--you might know her as Lady Luck.", "All the better. You've heard of beginner's luck, haven't you? To play the games, you'll need to purchase casino coins from the exchange desk. Go! Enjoy!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["(another soldier) Exploring are we? Might wanna be careful in here. Someone spotted a Cie'th in one of the tunnels, deeper in the ruins. We haven't seen a Cie'th on Cocoon for several years now. There's definitely something spooky going on here. I hope someone takes care of it soon.", "Wise decision. They say someone spotted a Cie'th. It was in one of the excavated tunnels.", "I hear a Cie'th is wandering around in the ruins. Hopefully some brave soul will deal with it.", "You think can handle one of those monsters? Maybe you should just leave it to the soldiers. A creature like that shouldn't even be here. With the paradox effect thrown in, there's no telling what it's capable of. Watch your step, and be ready for anything.", "Cie'th are shambling monsters created by the fal'Cie, right? It just creeps me out.", "They say the Cie'th was seen in the tunnels further in. Did you spot anything yet?", "(auto-talk) The reports say you handled that Cie'th in the ruins. Now I can sleep at night. We learned that all Cie'th were once normal human beings. And their only salvation lies in a merciful death. Such a tragic fate."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Choco boco lina! Welcome! Get your traveling products here at Chocolina's emporium! The beauty's all mine, but the products can be yours but only if you show me the money! This might be a once in a lifetime choco mazing opportunity, so don't miss out!", 'Have a fantabulous day!', "Have you seen that big ol' giant? Where'd he come from? Someone sure wasted their time and hard-earned money making something that big! I don't like seeing materials go to waste like that, but hey, what can I do? I can open up my shop! That's what I can do!", "You know I'm counting on you. Everyone is!", "If it's the giant you want to take down, then take a look around!", "Oh my gosh! I can't believe you really did it! You subdued that big ol' hunk of a meanie! You just saved us all from a devastating fate! Now that we're all safe, what say we find a way to spend some of that money?", "If you ever need a hand with anything, you know where to find me! I'll be right here!", 'Howdy, time-buddies! Care to help a choco-girl out by spending some gil?', "The scientists are so passionate about their work! They're working just as hard as ever, even in the dark! Speaking of passionate, I'm the most passionate person I know when it comes to making a living! And on that note, please peruse my passionately promising pick of pieces!", "I know it's a little dark in here, but I paid my electric bill, I swear!", "A little darkness can't stop me. I light up the room with my luminous character!", "The sun feels so amazing! Time for my feathers to soak up some of that good o' vitamin D for extra fluff! Oh! Choco-boco-lina! Sorry, didn't see you there!", "Thank you for shopping here on this bright and sunny day! I think it's time to hit the beach, don't you?", "I'm in a great mood today! A bright new future and bright new feathers! Welcome!", "I can't stand to even think about flan. They're slimy and gooey and sticky and goopy! So gross! Hey, there! I'll sell you some great stuff, so in return, I think you should take care of that giant flan! You know what I mean by 'take care,' right?", "Oh, thank you thank you thank you! And don't forget to 'take care' of the flan! You promised!", "I'm happy to sell you whatever you need, as long as you promise to kill that piece of goo!", 'I have super low, everyday prices! So no haggling, all right?', 'Well, thank you kindly!', 'Pssst, hey there! Wanna see what I got?', "I'll have something extra special for you next time!", 'Bargains, bargains everywhere!', 'Until we meet again! Choco-boco-lina!', "Welcome to my shop! Take a breather and survey Chocolina's charmingly cheap chest of charity!", "Thanks again! You're becoming quite the regular!", 'Welcome, Master. I am here to serve your every need. Just kidding! Choco-boco-lina!', "You'll come and see me again, won't you... ? Choco... ?", 'I really hope to see you back here soon!', 'I have to say, you have a really good eye!', 'See you later, choco-gator!', 'Everyone comes to me to stock up on their time-traveling goods!', 'Retail therapy is a great stress-reliever!', "I'm Chocolina--a busy little choco-bee flying around time to serve your needs!", 'Did you come to check out my chocotastic selection of goods?', "Meeting like this is fate. Won't you buy a little something to remember me by?", 'Welcome, you and you! What brings you to my fantastical shop today?', 'Step right up, folks! You want something? You know I got it!', 'Welcome one and all to Casa de Chocolina, the only store within goddess knows how many years!', "(moans) Thinking about the C'ieth makes me so sad. They used to be regular people, you know? They lived their lives just like you and me. Well, not exactly like me, of course, since I'm not human. I feel so blue, but I might feel better if you buy something.", 'Thank you kindly. I hope my shop is helping people in some way, no matter how indirectly.', "Welcome. I'm down in the dumps of timelessness. Buy something if you want. Or not.", "It's like the liveliness has been sucked out of the Augusta Tower lately. The people there are all so quiet and almost... robot-like. Although, I'm not human so what do I know? Anyway, back to business. Open up that wallet and shower me with gil!", "It's really quiet around here, so I've been talking to myself a lot. Trying to keep things lively, you know?", 'So for my lucky customers today, you get a big dose of spirit and zest along with your purchase!', "(squeals) You there! Are you lost, too? I don't know how I ended up here! And I can't seem to find a way out! I really need your help to get out of this bind! First, buy something from my shop. Then, look for an exit so I can get outta here!", 'Love you! And find that exit-STAT!', "Choco-boco-lina! If there's anything I can do for you, just holler!", "You look way too serious! It's like you're about to head off to a final showdown with your nemesis or something. If that's the case, you should spend an absurd amount of gil at my shop. It might help you win! Come on! Lighten up and pull that gil out of your wallet!", "It doesn't matter whether you win or lose. The only thing that matters is whether I win or lose in this game called life.", "Chocolina's shop guarantees a good life at a good price. Or you money back!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["I'm collecting parts for my computer terminal. If you've got any, I'd be happy to buy them from you. What I really want to get my hands on, is the battery used for one of the older models, like the kind they used on Cocoon. It wasn't a very popular model, so the parts are scarce. I saw it in a store window once. I got excited and ran in, but it turned out that the item had already been bought.", "If you have the battery for that older model, I'm willing to pay a generous price.", "They discontinued that model, so there's no way I can get the parts at a store.", "Really? You'll help me try and find the battery? It might be an impossible task. I already called every store in the book with no luck. But if you say you can get your hands on it, I believe you! Thanks for doing this! You want to know what I'll be using it for? I'm a collector. I want to get my hands on all the retro electronics I can.", "I'm looking to obtain the battery of the older model terminals. I'm willing to pay whatever it takes. It's been ten years since they stopped producing them. No wonder the parts are so hard to find.", "Is this what I think it is? You really found one! How did you get your hands on something like this? Would this be enough to compensate you for your trouble? You say you want to know why I'm paying this much for a piece of junk? Hmm, you two popped out of that gate, didn't you? Well, in that case, I suppose you'll believe me if I tell you then. The reason I'm collecting things that can almost be classified as antiques, is because I'm from the past. I'm a time traveler, just like you. I was thrown into the future by a paradox, and so far, I haven't been able to find my way back. But please, don't tell anyone about my situation. I love my life here and I don't want anything to disrupt that. I even have a beautiful wife who adores me! Can you get to the bottom of the mystery of the gates? I don't want more people getting swallowed up by a paradox and finding themselves in a foreign time. I made the most of it, but I don't know if others will be able to do the same.", "(auto-talk) I just don't want anyone else to become a victim of accidental time travel. At the Academy, they call it something fancy. They refer to it as the time dislocation phenomenon."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["What do I do? This is hopeless... Hm? You wanna know what's wrong? Well, I can't get this stupid drawer in my desk to open. You're thinking, 'She's forgotten her password,' aren't you? Well, you're wrong! The stupid lock on the stupid drawer is broken. And I really need a file I left in there.", 'So what can I do... ?', "How can you open a lock if it's broken?", "My file's in that drawer. How do I get it out?", "You can get it open? Oh, but don't just go busting the desk apart. I need a non-violent solution.", "Yes, this is the file! That's amazing! How did you get it out? These are my personal notes. I have research ideas and theories and all sorts of things in here. Thank you, now I can get back to work. Wait, this can't be right. This is my file, but I don't remember writing these notes. Augusta Tower? Duplicates? This isn't my field. And the date it was saved hasn't even happened yet. Don't tell me... these are my notes from the future? Is it possible that the drawer wasn't really broken at all, but somehow phased out of time? Was my desk the site of a paradox!? This is huge! Thank you for your assistance!", "(auto-talk) That file was definitely written by my future self. But the shorthand is so cryptic, I have no idea what I was trying to explain. According to my notes, in a few year's time, that trainee Alyssa will climb pretty high in the Academy. I wonder if that really happens..."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['(offscreen, as Hope watches) Daddy!', 'Yeah! Daddy!', 'Yeah.', 'Yeah!']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["I am a researcher of monsters. My database contains profiles of every creature in existence, from Cocoon to the furthest reaches of Gran Pulse. Yes, I have them all. Ah, it's been quite the trial. I scoured the records, you see, compiling data from the most obscure Academy files. My work is a thing of beauty. If anyone has research that rivals my perfect database, I would certainly like to see it.", "Not up to the task? I don't honestly expect anyone to improve on my work in any case.", 'I wager there is not a single monster anywhere that has escaped my scholarly gaze. I challenge you to find a database anywhere that claims superiority over mine.', "Hm? You believe there are monstrosities even my research has overlooked? Very well. Let us see proof of your words. Return to me when you think your datalog has captured details on every monster. Do you understand? I do mean 'every' single monster.", 'Well, well. This is a significant amount of data, even for a specialist in the field. You surprise me. It still falls short of my work, but this is a first-class database.', "Yes? You say you've tracked down and recorded data on all the monsters you could find? Hm!? What's this!? You've discovered a creature missing from my database!? A new species... I have been remiss. The monsters appearing with the paradox leave behind no bodily remains. It stands to reason that their data should remain unrecorded. I thank you. You have given me new purpose. The next database I compile will truly be a work of perfection.", "We'll need to rethink our current system of classification.", 'This new data will prove invaluable for overturning established theories.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Have you heard about this legend? Many years ago, there was a young girl who worshipped the seeress of Paddra. With much training and dedication, the girl secured herself a position as one of the protectors of the seeress. But when war broke out in the city, the girl was fooled by the enemy and wound up betraying the one she set out to protect. Charged with treason, the girl faced severe punishment. She was turned into a C'ieth, and was forced to wander the Yaschas Massif for all of eternity. According to the legend, she's still there, waiting for someone to defeat her and help put her soul to rest. I don't know how much truth there is to that story... ... but if you ever spot a C'ieth in the ruins, you should do it justice and kill it. You'll be doing it a favor by putting it out of its misery.", 'Even after death, she continues to pay for her mistake. My heart goes out to that poor girl.', "There's a C'ieth, a girl, wandering through the Yaschas Massif.", "If you want to set her free, I won't stop you. But remember... Even though she used to be a human being, she's a monster now. Stay on your toes out there, or you'll end up losing your life.", "So, tell me, have you run into the C'ieth I told you about? When you fight a C'ieth, you have to forget that it was once human. If you dwell on that fact, it could easily get you killed. You don't want that, do you?", "You found a mysterious crystal? Let's see. You're right--this is no ordinary substance. If we can obtain a few more, we might be able to discover their true properties.", "(auto-talk) The C'ieth left behind a shiny stone and disappeared? I wonder if that was her--the girl from the legend. You know, I'd like to think it was. I forgot to mention it before, but there's more to the legend. You see, if the girl was ever freed from her cursed fate as a C'ieth, her new responsibility will be to protect her new master from harm. So they say. Perhaps her soul is in that stone, determined to protect the ones who freed her from her horrid fate."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Please! D-don't kill me!", 'Sorry, I thought you were gonna kill me. Wait, are you a search party?', "I couldn't believe what I was seeing. The corporal and I were thrown out of the ship, and when I came to, 'it' was standing right in front of me. Listen up, I'm only gonna say this once. Don't go any further. That thing... That monster... It's not something you want to mess with! If you value your lives at all, I suggest you turn around and go back. I'll go check on Torreno.", "It's just like you said. Torreno's leg is in pretty bad shape, but other than that, he's all right for now.", "Just promise me you won't go any further. No human can go up against something like that.", "There's no way the corporal's still alive.", "Are you joking? You plan on taking on that monster? Come on, you're just gonna get yourselves killed! The corporal ordered me to cooperate? No way! He knows that no one has the strength to go up against that thing.", "The corporal's always been one to shoulder all the responsibility. It definitely sounds like something he would do. Okay, then how about this: what's the corporal's call sign?", 'See? I knew it. You guys are lying through your teeth.', "If you met the corporal like you say you did, you should know his call sign. Tell me the corporal's call sign.", "That's right. So you really did talk to the corporal. Fine, I'll tell you everything you want to know. A powerful energy source was being sent to that area from another time. In fact, it was so powerful that it even blew up our calibrator! The creature's getting its powers from a different time. Getting rid of that power source should weaken it considerably. Take this with you, so you don't get lost along the way.", "There's no way to kill that sinister creature unless you terminate its power source. It's like the beast is devouring energy from a different time. Is that even possible?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["We've come to pull you out of this fantasy of yours.", "We're just showing you a way out. You're the one who made the decision to wake up and leave this world. If you hadn't rejected the fake Lightning, we would never have been able to reach you, and you'd still be stuck in your dream.", "Tch. Guess our time's up, huh?", 'See you around.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['Serah, come on!', "(auto-talk) You're askin' for it! Serah! You okay!? Is Lebreau okay? We gotta handle this mess!", "All right, everyone, listen up. The meteorite hit over there. We're gonna go check it out.", "Serah! Still in one piece? We're seein' lots of unfriendly critters around that meteorite. (notices Noel) Oho... Who's this?", "Is that right? (He gets up close.) I'm Gadot!", "You better not. Anything happens to Serah and the boss'll string your carcass out to dry.", "Huh!? Who d'ya think you are!? (runs off) Hut, two, three, four! Hut, two, three, four!", "(auto-talk) Guess that Noel's seen a few fights before. Don't wander off alone! What's goin' on inside that rock? What do I tell everyone?", "(grabbing him) You're full of it!", "Whaddya mean, 'Time Gate'?", '(auto-talk) That impact site is off-limits for now.', "It's not safe near that thing. There's monsters everywhere.", "Hey, Serah. Listen. What's the deal with you and that Noel guy, anyway?", "Let you run off with some con artist? I'd beat him half to death first.", 'Wish Snow was here right now.', "Gotta be careful out there. Still a lot of nasties roamin' around.", "This Noel guy, what's he after?", 'Still a bit early for patrols.', "Hey there, Serah. Sorry, but I'm not lettin' anyone near that meteorite just yet.", "How should I know. Even if I did, I wouldn't tell you.", "N-no, I got no idea! You're not actually swallowing any of that crap, are ya?", 'That meteorite is off-limits.', "That Noel guy... Stirrin' up a bunch of trouble.", "He's up to somethin'. I can smell it.", "Keep an eye out. Never know when some creepy-crawly'll pop outta nowhere.", "Hey, I don't see why not.", "Maqui'll do it.", '(nudging him) Hey, shut up.', "(pointing) You know what you're doin', right?", 'Hey, what about Serah!?', "Hey, guys! You're back. Not that you've been away that long. A few hours ago, right? That's when we saw you off. But look at you now... You've changed somehow. Like you've gone through a lot in a short time. So Noel was tellin' the truth about time travel and all that jazz. Don't tell the townsfolk, though. Who knows how they'll react? You gotta be tired. Go home, get some rest.", "To think we said good-bye to you guys just a few minutes ago. Back almost before you left, ha! I have a hard time wrappin' my head around all this time travelin' stuff.", "Journey's not over yet, right? If you've got things to take care of in town, go do 'em.", "You need something from me? Speak fast, I'm busy. The paths need fixing, and the guards need supervising!", 'Leave the monster hunting up to us. You just concentrate on finding Lightning and getting her back safe and sound.', "Hey, you found your way back! You didn't happen to bump into the boss while you were out there, did ya?", 'If you see the bossman, tell him Gadot says hey. Oh, and tell him he still owes me for that time I bought him lunch!', "Hope you guys bring back Snow and Lightning. You'd better hurry back before we all forget about you guys!", 'Oh, and next time, bring us back a little something from your trip, will ya?', "Why don't you do it?", 'Not in your bed, for starters.', "Hey, let's go.", "Man, I'm hungry. What's for lunch anyway?", 'You were sleeping like a baby out there, You sure do have it easy, Serah.', "Do I like it? Well, there aren't as many monsters as there used to be. I liked chasin' 'em off. Things have gotten kinda boring. Other than that, no complaints. Anyway, you better get a move on. You-know-who's waitin'.", "You're not gonna go inside?", 'No more catnaps on the beach.', 'Stay close to the village.', "There are still dangerous monsters prowlin' around out there."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['Final Fantasy XIII-2: The story so far...', "It's her knife. I found it near the base of the pillar.", "When monsters like these are cornered, they cause a spacetime vortex to appear. An electromagnetic shock usually shuts them down. It's been a while, Serah.", "I'm grateful you remember me.", 'Director of Academy Research, Team Alpha. Hope Estheim, at your service. And you, you must be Noel.', "You appeared here with Serah some years ago, at the Bresha Ruins. Subsequently, we analyzed the gate and forecast your reappearance at this location. To be honest, I didn't really believe that time travel was possible. But here you are. (takes Serah's hands) I'm really glad you're safe.", "For me, it's as if time has stopped. Everyone I knew is gone.", "Not just Serah. Snow as well. And Sazh and his boy. You all disappeared from my life. It's been ten years now.", 'When the paradox occurred some ten years ago, I thought if I could solve it, maybe you would all come back.', "There's something I want to show you both. We can continue our conversation as we walk. Alyssa (clinging to Hope) I'll show the way.", 'A sense of duty. Vanille, Fang, Lightning... They turned to crystal so that we might live. It was an enormous sacrifice.', "They put the future in our hands. We're in a position to build a society based on human technology, no longer subject to the whim of the fal'Cie. That's the gift we've been given.", "Serah, you've just stepped into the near future. You must be curious about a few things.", "Our goal of creating a society independent of the fal'Cie is slowing but surely becoming a reality. We're seeing all previous opposition fade away, and people are coming together under the leadership of the Academy.", 'Thank you.', 'The time distortions spawn hostile creatures. Until we can resolve the paradox, we need military force to repel threats. These armed patrols are essential for our safety.', "It's hard to believe it's really been ten years. So much time has passed.", "I always had doubts. And it wasn't just me. Sazh had them as well.", "Yes. He couldn't believe that Lightning would just 'up and leave Serah like that.' After all, she was the one who said we shouldn't face things alone, that we should stick together.", "I'm glad to see you're doing well, Serah.", "I believe it. Good old Snow. I'm glad to hear he's alive.", "Have faith. I think I understand what Snow's going through. He's trying to save Vanille and Fang. Not to mention Lightning as well. We're only here today because they chose to bear the weight of a world.", 'I wonder how the others are doing.', "We've been out of touch. Sazh took Dajh to live on Gran Pulse, and he was flying airships the last I heard. Then suddenly, they both disappeared. I... I searched everywhere but never found them.", "Yes, and I can't tell you how much it means to have you here now. Sazh and Snow may have set off on different paths, but I've started to think that in the end, we're all headed towards the same goal.", "It's been ten years already...", 'A great many things have happened.', 'According to our research, we believe they constituted an entire nation, a polity that was ruled by a seeress.', 'Yes. The seeress would read the fates, see the future, and guide her country.', '(extending his hand to Serah) Here.', 'The seeress Yeul foresaw the future destruction of this city. Some citizens wanted to try to avert the disaster. Others felt that they should simply abandon their homes and run. A few fell into despair, and took their own lives. The divided populace clashed. The nation was torn apart by civil war.', 'Huh. So you know the story?', "This way. Here, this is what lies at the heart of our paradox. The Oracle Drive. We've been giving it careful study.", 'Wait, you know of these devices?', "The Oracle Drive appears to be some kind of recording apparatus from ancient times. We've excavated a number of the devices. However, the recordings depict... things that cannot be possible. Perhaps you should see for yourselves.", 'The device was excavated from an ancient part of the ruins. We used carbon dating methods to determine age. The device and the recording stored within are several centuries old.', "Someone in the past recorded this vision of the future. Perhaps it was the seeress, Yeul, herself. What we're concerned about, however, is this. You'll have to excuse the image quality.", 'Yes, I think so. We need to conduct further analysis to be certain.', "No. We've tested both the device and data and everything is nominal. Yet, when we try to view the recording, we get this. Perhaps it's not the recording that's broken... ... it's the immediate spacetime in which we are located.", 'Yes, I believe so...', 'This object serves as a key, is that right? We tried to make it work ourselves, but with no success.', 'You understand why I wanted to show you the Oracle Drive?', "Yes. It's not much of a clue, but I thought you should see it all the same. And I wanted you to see how far we've come.", "We're still excavating, gathering clues, and putting things together, but Paddra was likely founded before the War of Transgression.", "We've still barely scratched the surface here.", 'The Oracle Drive is my main field of research.', "I'm curious to see the uncorrupted images.", 'I wonder what sort of person was this seeress.', "Snow, you don't mess around, do you?", "I don't know. But... I think they'll be here soon.", 'I have something I want to show you.', "This is a recording of the future. We're unable to identify the location or circumstances. There is one thing we are sure about, however. And remember, we don't know what era this is. Lightning is alive in that place. In my memory, Lightning disappeared after the battle with Orphan. But she's living somewhere in the future.", "She's out there.", 'And you will find her, Serah. After all, you traveled through time and found me. Many years of research have finally borne fruit. It all began with the Oracle Drive. We excavated it from ruins many centuries old.. ... yet it recorded an image of Cocoon supported on a pillar of crystal. It was an impossibility, an enigma. Impossible... but a reality nonetheless. This is when I learned what I must do.', 'If it was possible to journey through time and look into the future... ... then it must also be possible to travel backwards and change the past.', 'I wanted to change history, make things better. Not just bring Lightning back. But Vanille, and Fang... ... and my mother.', "Chasing the impossible, you might say. But, you've made me realize something. It's clear to me now we are not the only ones who are intervening in history. The past has already been changed. Serah, you are the only one who remembers a time when Lightning survived the fall of Cocoon...", 'Not necessarily rewritten. It could be the original prophecy, restored as it once was. Perhaps a continuation of the first recording.', 'It might not be necessary to travel to the specific time and place.', 'The future depends on what we do now, right? Yes, there is chance Cocoon will fall, but we can start working now to prevent it from happening.', 'We can at least work to mitigate the damage. If we begin our research now, we have time. Then, should Cocoon indeed fall, we can help protect the planet and save the victims.', "Yes. Let's change the future.", 'Serah?', "Time will separate us, but we'll share a common goal.", 'I see. Valhalla... otherwise known as the Unseen World.', 'She was unable to do anything on her own, so she turned to the one person she trusted more than anyone. Yes, it is possible. Although the idea raises even more questions.', 'Solve the paradoxes. Correct the timeline. Restore history as it should have been... Then you will find Lightning alive. Of that, I am sure.', 'Noel, you were born in a different future. In our world, in our future, Cocoon survives. When the paradoxes are eliminated, Cocoon remains safe in the sky.', 'Yes, I believe so. My task is to save Cocoon.', 'Believe in your future. You can bring the people you love together again.', "I'll try to help in any way I can.", "There is still so much we don't know...", 'It does give us a reason to hope.', "Go see what's happening.", 'What is this?', 'Welcome to the future you saved.', "Now is that a polite way to greet old friends? I mean, we haven't seen each other in, what, how many years?", 'Well, exactly. So we were forced to reevaluate the project, and eventually abandoned it.', "We were following the wrong path to the future. If the Proto fal'Cie had managed to get control of Cocoon... ... it would have made itself the second Eden, and we'd be back where we began.", 'Really? Then we owe you our lives. Thank you.', "Each ore cluster provides only a certain amount of power. The Thirteenth Ark, for example, requires a single Graviton Core. We're going to need multiple cores... that we can't seem to find.", "We could use the help. With you two on the case, we'll have those cores in no time.", 'The Academy has been making progress on the development of a paradox weapon. A very powerful weapon that feeds on time-distorting energies.', "Exactly. There's a possibility we may come up against the man who appears in the Oracle Drive recordings. The war has already begun. And we're fighting to protect the future itself.", "A Chaos Crystal. It's a solidified chunk of paradox energy. But according to the data, it doesn't exist in this time period.", "I knew I could count on you. Once you've found the crystal, I can build you a prototype.", 'Serah, did you really do it?', 'I know we can do it.', "Let's all fight together. We'll follow you to the future by a different path. There are things there I have to protect.", 'Leaving without even a farewell?', 'Sorry. I was just remembering something. There was a time when I almost lost myself because I had so much hate in me. And then some friends showed me a way out.', "It all began back then. I remember, Serah. Weren't you the first one who said you wanted to 'save Cocoon'? It was because Snow and Lightning vowed to carry out your wishes that we all came together back then. And to this day, Vanille and Fang still keep Cocoon safe.", "Yes, but the old ark is almost finished. It will fall soon. It's going to be hard for many of us to abandon our old home.", "I've had the great fortune to be helped by many people over the years. Serah and Noel, you are the ones who showed me how the future should be. You gave us all a motive. You helped us make the Academy what it has become.", 'Once preparations are complete, we plan to journey ahead one hundred years. I want to be there. I want to see the raising of Cocoon with my own eyes.', "Greetings, Serah in the future. Can you hear me? I'm sending you the access codes for the supply spheres. The final battle with your ultimate nemesis draws near. I hope the contents are of some use to you.", "Good, you're okay.", "Get on board. He's the best pilot we have. (Serah and Noel nod and head for the ship.) Quickly.", '(from the bridge of another ship) We can catch him!', "You're right. I'll see you on the new Cocoon--don't be late!", '(nods) Take care!', 'Come on, Sazh.', "Thank you, Sazh. Thank you for saving them. They've kept our world safe for centuries. But now they can rest, and join us in our new ark.", "The gates haven't been shut down yet. Which means, the timeline must still be unstable.", "It's okay. Serah and Noel will fix it. They just need more time.", "(narrating) This is our ark--our haven. It will be called 'Bhunivelze'... ... and it shall be the new home for the human race.", 'Noel? But why... ? You were safe, everything was fine.', 'You mean Serah... she saw this vision?', 'We can catch him!', 'Snow, how did you... ?', "You can't just drop a bomb like that and take off. You always do what you want, even if it means leaving people behind. You haven't changed at all!", 'What can I do?', 'Me?', '(nods) Right.', 'Thirteen different eras? Not one to sit still, huh?', "There's no stopping you, is there? Go on then."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Have you heard of the 'Silver Petal'? It's an extremely rare plant that blooms with stunning, silvery flowers. My niece has been pestering me, saying she wanted to see one for real. So when I heard they grow in this area, I decided to go look for it. But I'd forgotten one thing. The Silver Petal only blooms when the weather is cold, and snow is falling. Seems I've completely missed the season. I don't suppose you could find it anywhere right now. You see, that niece I mentioned is such a selfish and demanding little princess. But the pouty thing she does is just so cute! Ah, what's her favorite uncle supposed to do?", "Hey, I can't force you to go looking. I mean, it's not in bloom anyway, right?", "If I had a Silver Petal, it'd make her so happy...", "A flower that only blooms when it's snowing... where would I find something like that?", "Oh? You'll go look for one for me? Is it snowing somewhere that I don't know about? Well, I won't hold out too much hope.", 'Did you find the plant? Is the Silver Petal in bloom?', "I just can't say no to our little princess.", "You actually brought me a Silver Petal? But where on Pulse did you find it? Are you really giving this to me? Thank you! But I must confess, my niece is no longer around to admire it. On the day that Cocoon fell, she died alongside many others. It broke our hearts--she was just 5 years old. I'll never forget how much happiness she brought to our family. Such a sweet girl, even if she was spoiled rotten. We were never able to find the place where she fell. I'll put the flower on the grave and say a prayer to her memory. Do you think our little princess will like the Silver Petal?", '(auto-talk) We should keep that in mind as we strive to build a better world. When Cocoon fell from the sky, a lot of children lost their lives in the chaos.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["With this many monsters prowling the area, all we can do is take them out one at a time, starting with the ones in front of us. According to my extensive research, there should be some kind of device that's been recording the biology of these monsters for some time now. If only I could find that valuable piece of equipment. It would certainly make dealing with the monsters a lot easier.", "(chuckles) Don't worry about it. I was just unloading on you two.", "Hey there, you two. Is there any way I could convince you to help me look for a recording device? It's vital. I really want to get my hands on that monster data. But I don't know where in the world I can find the device.", "You mean, you'll do it? You'll help me look for the recording device? I knew I could count on you two!", "(chuckles) I'm counting on you two! Bring me back some good news! Please, if you can find the recording device and bring it to me, I would owe you so much!", "The recording device! You found it! Let's see here... This should be chock-full of data. There's enough information here to keep me busy for years to come! Thank you! You've been a great help. This breakthrough will help the military immensely! And the compensation they'll give me won't hurt either. I can't thank you enough! Your efforts may have saved many lives! This is just a small token of my gratitude. Please, take it.", '(auto-talk) Well, hello there, you two! I want to thank you again for your help. Heh heh. With the money I got from the higher-ups, I plan on taking a vacation.']

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Get ahold of yourself! Lightning can't protect you anymore. You have to look after yourself now. Do you hear me? Your sister's dead. She can't help you!", "Now don't start whining. We agreed to take care of things while he was gone.", 'Morning!', "Hey, do we have to go through this again? I told you, we look out for each other. I won't tell Snow. Noel will be our little secret.", 'Good mooorning, kupo!!!', 'Mornings are what I do best.', 'Time for you to move on, huh?', 'Better start getting lunch ready.', "If you want to believe what Noel says, that's your decision.", "The guys have been acting kinda weird. Wonder what they're up to.", 'You know, I was thinking, if Noel here really is from the future, he must be pretty curious about this time period.', "We were all born and raised on Cocoon. But three years ago, our home basically fell out of the sky. We couldn't rely on the broken fal'Cie anymore, so most of us made the decision to move to Pulse.", 'Well, it was. But on Pulse, we had to deal with new hardships, like vicious monsters and a lack of provisions.', "Yeah. But things eventually settled down and some former military types helped get things organized. Now there's a growing town at the base of Cocoon's pillar. The guys who used to be in charge are long gone.", "Our leader, Snow, suggested we live somewhere near the ocean. We used to live in a seaside town on Cocoon, so it was like we were rebuilding our home. Snow and the rest of us were used to fighting monsters and getting our hands dirty. So we pretty much settled back into our old way of life. Snow's not around right now, so we do the best we can. But if Lightning were back, everything would be so much better.", 'How about it, future boy? Do you want a quick history lesson?', 'I know people have changed since we came down to Pulse. But some folks have even learned how to use magic, like our Serah.', "Three years ago, our home, Cocoon, came close to breaking apart. After that, most of the residents moved down to Pulse. it was pure chaos for a while, but now the government has things under control. Our group, NORA, used to hang out at one of the coastal towns on Cocoon. That's why our leader, Snow, decided to make this place our new home away from home. Lastly, there's one more thing you should know. It's about Serah's older sister, Lightning-- she disappeared into the pillar holding up Cocoon. Serah was the only one who wouldn't accept it. But then again, if you're telling the truth about what you saw in that other world... ... then maybe Serah's right, and we're the ones who had it all wrong.", 'Are you sure you can look after her?', "If you ever need a good meal, you just come on back here. There's a NORA special with your name on it.", "(approaching the group) Why don't you guys go fess up? Go on. You, too.", 'You can go. But you have to come back in one piece. Promise?', "(putting her hand on Gadot's shoulder) Gadot...", "Don't tell me--you guys forgot to pack a lunch? How much luggage CAN you take with you through that machine anyway? Any security checks in the future?", "If there's anything you need to take care of while you're here, go get that out of the way. If not, then get the heck outta here, already!", 'Back so soon? What happened? Get a little homesick, did ya?', "Oh, wait, I know! You couldn't stay away from my NORA special, could you? I regret to inform you that lunch is no longer being served.", "Or maybe... You guys never left town at all and you're just playing us for fools!", "Serah... You ran into Snow, didn't you?", "So you really did travel through time, huh? Wait, don't tell me! I don't want to know all the details just yet.", "You'll have plenty of time to tell me about your journey once it's over. I don't want to have to wait in suspense to find out the ending.", "(sighs) I'll get her up. Hey, Serah! Wake up! (Serah wakes in a flash.) What are you doing, sleeping out here?", 'Come on, Serah.', "Didn't you just eat?", 'I know school is out right now, but what will your students think if they see Teacher dozing on the grass?', 'The Void Beyond who? Now, which do you think is a dream--me, or this Void place?', "Where else would it be? And let me tell you, the monsters out here are real, too. So why don't you run home, pronto?", 'Ah, girl, I would love to be you.', 'Not a care in the world, snoozing in the grass. Must be nice being in Serah Land all the time!', 'What are you doing, standing there gawking at me? Are you still dreaming of moogles and moondust?', "You're supposed to be a teacher. At least try to act like you know what's what."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Excuse me, I don't mean to take up too much of your time, but did you see some strange lights last night? Someone witnessed three stars falling from the sky. I thought it could be a meteorite of some sort, but there's no evidence of that anywhere. It's possible it burned up before it reached our atmosphere. If you see anything that looks out of place, please let me know.", 'If you change your mind, please let me know.', 'Someone witnessed several shooting stars last night. Would you mind helping us with our investigation?', 'Please let me know if you find anything that might help us figure this out.', "I'm counting on you. Come to me if you notice anything strange. By the way, the witnesses noticed something interesting about the stars. They said that all three of them were different colors. Three different colored stars falling from the sky... It sounds like it could be something quite mystical, don't you think?", "I'll take a look if you find anything. The witnesses claim that three different-colored stars fell from the night sky yesterday.", 'So you were able to obtain two of these mysterious minerals. The colors seem to match the accounts of the incident. Perhaps the crystals emitted some kind of light while falling out of the sky. If only we could find the last one, we would have enough to get to the bottom of this.', "You found three crystals, all of a different color? Can I see them? These must be what fell from the sky. And I can think of only one explanation for what they are. Of course, I must warn you, it's-it's not a very scientific explanation. Even though I'm a scientist, I try to keep an open mind. This is why I think it's possible there's some truth behind what I read in an ancient transcript. Long ago... ... the seeress of Paddra offered three prayers to the night sky and made a prophecy. She predicted that her three prayers would take the form of stars and fall from the sky in the course of time. The colors of the three stars were stated clearly in the prophecy. It just so happens that they match the colors of the crystals down to a T! This can't just be a coincidence of some sort. The crystals are yours to keep. The people of ancient times believed that the prayers of the seeress had powers of protection. This is her gift to you from the past.", "(auto-talk) I wonder if the seeress saw into the future. Did she know that you would be the ones to find her prayers? Some people think this prophecy is an old wive's tale. But I believe it. Even magic exists in our world, after all."]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ["Me and my buddy are out here doing research on monsters in the area, but I can't get ahold of him. Can you find him? He should have some sort of message for me.", "Tch. All right, I'll ask someone else.", "If you find my buddy, tell him I'm worried sick. Boy, I hope he's all right.", "I don't want to impose, but do you think you can get in touch with him for me? He's been gone a while.", "I'm counting on you two! Oh, by the way, he's a slightly odd fellow, a natural-born jokester, if you will.", "Have you found him yet? He's very energetic, always laughing at something. I'm a bit worried about my friend. He's a tough fellow, so I'm sure he's not dead or anything.", 'Thanks for trying! Or should I say, thanks for crying... at my jokes!', "I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down!", "You brought back the message from my buddy, did you? Let's see here... He discovered a new species of monsters? Could that be the missing link between the realms of spacetime? He did it! I knew he had it in him. What's that? You say he left me another message? He said that I'm his one and only buddy till the day that he drops dead? That's just like him. You already know, right? I'm not like you guys. I don't belong in this world anymore. I ended up here by a simple twist of fate. If you see him again, tell him he needs to find himself a new buddy that'll watch his back. Got it? Anyway, thanks, guys!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
Dialogues: ['That time was lost; yet time continued onward.', 'Divine Etro. Go peacefully to your rest. I will stand guard over your legacy.', 'This endless realm is awash with sadness. Life and death lose all meaning under the rolling waves of chaos. (The scene pans out to show a distant shore.) Valhalla. The currents of time do not touch its shores.', 'In this world of lost moments, I begin my life anew.', 'Save it.', 'Damn you...', 'Odin!', 'Forgotten time, be reborn!', 'Not kidding around, huh?', 'Come on, then.', "What's he up to?", 'So you want to destroy everything?', "We're done here. Say good-bye.", "You're finished, Caius!", "Let's end this. You're done!", "You're finished, Caius!", 'Valhalla. You prayed for a miracle, and that brought you here. Or am I wrong?', 'From Valhalla, I can see everything.', 'Lightning.', 'Time for a real fight.', 'Gonna get worse!', "This is not your battle. There's something else I need you to do.", 'Bring my sister to me. Her name is Serah.', "You'll need to use the portal. Your time-gazing friend should have told you how it works.", "Because you're the only one who can. You crossed the Void and made it to Valhalla. You can find Serah, and together you can change the future.", 'A good luck charm. Give him to Serah.', "Get to the gate. I'm counting on you.", 'Serah.', 'My hopes go with you, Noel Kreiss. Become an arrow through time, and speed your way to Serah. Be there for her... because I no longer can.', 'Time flows without pause. In a world where I no longer exist, the future is about to change.', 'Serah. The truth still survives. But only you remember it.', 'Final Fantasy XIII-2: The story so far...', 'I know your name. Noel Kreiss.', '(narrating) Serah, you set out on your journey for my sake. You believed in a promise. You believed in a future you could not see. I will keep fighting here, at the end of the world. I know you will come. I believe in you.', '(narrating) When reaching for the future, we sometimes fall into the past.', 'As we gaze upon events that cannot be changed, our hearts grow bitter with regret.', "(narrating) Serah, forgive me. That was a past you never should have had to deal with. But now, because of your courage, the timelines have one less knot to unravel. If I could, I would thank you for what you have accomplished. But I can't. Not just yet.", '(narrating) People always say the future will be better. They believe the hardships of the present fade with the passage of time. And so we hope, waiting for a future brighter than today. But Serah, remember this... As you walk towards a brighter tomorrow, you have to look back to your past.', "Serah, I'm sorry.", 'I believe you.', "(narrating) Hope dreamed of changing the past. The weight of history drove him forward. But now, he's turning to face the future, a future even more frightening than the past. Serah, do you believe, too? Do you believe in your own past?", "(narrating) Each reunion is a twist of the knife. The joy is ephemeral; it leaves fear in its wake... A fear that all too soon the time will come when you must bid farewell again. Yet you cannot help but long for the next encounter. Humanity's great frailty... We prefer past happiness to future uncertainty.", '(narrating) 10 AF. A large-scale distortion was observed in the Vile Peaks, a land filled with ancient debris. The Academy dispatched Blitz Squadron, an investigative unit, to check the area. The elite Academy force armed themselves with anti-paradox weapons. Their mission was simple - to find out just what was causing this spatial distortion. However, the airship carrying the crew disappeared within the clouds looming over the Vile Peaks. That day, six elite soldiers vanished without a trace. And it was my fault. I was responsible.', "(narrating) When two people part and go their separate ways, their memories split as well. Some people wish they could go back and be together like before. Others look forward to the day they can meet again. Serah, the future is yours. Follow your path. Don't stop now.", '(narrating) The power to influence the future... The power to alter destiny...', "Such an ability may, if one was not careful, change a person's fate for the worse. Such power was never meant for mortal man. There are none who possess the wisdom to wield it. Serah, you must seek out your own answers as you waver at the edge of despair.", 'Please, Serah. Banish this twisted reflection of the past back into the darkness.', "(narrating) This land will soon return to its original state. The shadow of a false Odin is not my burden to bear. (She is shown again looking down from one of the structures.) But if the men had died, nothing could have erased my guilt. I fought alongside those six men years ago. I thought they would have forgotten my existence by now. I find comfort in the fact... ... that people can disappear, but still continue to live on in others' memories. So, Serah. If you keep me in your thoughts, one day I am certain I will find my way home again.", "(narrating) I am no longer there. But they'll encounter a friend. My first comrade-in-arms, a man who treasured family more than anything. We did not meet here, but this is where we parted ways.", 'I am in Valhalla, isolated from others, engaged in a solitary battle.', 'Welcome home, Serah.', 'Because you want me to be.', "(stepping forward) You've changed history and you're back where you belong. This is it. Your adventure's over. (She walks to the other end of the pier, then turns back to Serah. She extends her arm.) Serah, come with me. Your family's waiting.", "Serah, let's go.", 'This is a future that I could not save.', "Do you doubt me? (Serah nods slightly.) No, it's good to doubt. You're growing up.", "Just listen, Serah. I'll explain everything. Everything that's happened to me in the past. And about the one who wants to destroy the future.", "(narrating) I felt a whirlwind of emotions. A large part of it was happiness. And relief was there, too. But somewhere inside, I still felt uneasy. Vanille and Fang were gone. And the world hung in silence. Our fight had just ended... ... but I couldn't relax. A new battle was about to begin. (Energy begins streaking around Lightning... ) What is that!? Watch out! (narrating) The events of that day tore open a portal to another world. (Back in the scene.) Get off me! (narrating) And from the depths of the rift appeared a darkness that had no place in our world-- an irresistible force that dragged me away to the edge of time. The screams of the dying had unlocked a gate-- A door that led directly to the throne of the goddess. Etro waited beyond the gate, and sent her miracles to the human world. But a creeping darkness slipped through, and threatened to devour our reality. Etro closed the gate, and warped the timeline. Time's flow was altered, and existence itself was distorted. I was lost. The darkness caught me in its embrace, and wrote me out of history. (In the flashback, Lightning finds herself on the shore of Valhalla.) Where am I? (narrating) Valhalla. Beyond time. Beyond life and death. A netherworld of shifting gloom. The chaotic realm of the goddess Etro. What power had brought me to this alien shore? From Valhalla's heart, I could track the entire span of time. I gazed upon the future of mankind, and sensed Etro's divine will. (In the flashback, she is transformed into her new, feathery costume.) The goddess was fading away. If her spirit should cease to be, the world would descend into entropy. I made my choice. I will fight. (flashback of the fight with Caius) This man, Caius Ballad. He seeks to destroy all hope, and bring an end to the future. Though the battle might be endless, I will never give up. Etro has chosen us--her champions. And we cannot fail.", "I don't know. It was an enormous power. Something that shouldn't exist in this world. Only Etro can control the power and keep it contained in Valhalla. If she were to disappear, there would be nothing to stop it. And that's what Caius wants. He plans to find Etro sleeping in her temple, kill her, and release the power. The chaos would be unleashed into the realm of humans. Into our world, through the Unseen Gate.", 'When a person dies, her soul flies to the otherworld, and passes through that portal. If a great many people die at once, the gate must open wide to let them through.', 'Exactly. It would be unstoppable. The power of chaos would gush through the gate like floodwater through a broken dam.', 'Chaos would infect everything. It would become pure entropy, without life, or death, or time.', 'Yes. Caius is trying to create a world where time does not exist. If he can erase time...', "We have to face Caius on two fronts: in Valhalla, and in the world of humans. If we don't... We won't be able to change the future. I can't do it on my own. I need your help.", 'Yes. Everything will depend on you. I have to go to Valhalla, and stop Caius there. Can you do it?', "Right. Your good luck charm'll show the way.", "It's up to you to keep hope alive.", "It's up to you to keep hope alive."]

Man, thinking about this hurts my head!", 'Look at her. Asleep like a baby.', "it is a really nice day for a nap, I've gotta say.", "They can't wait for you to get back to NORA House.", "Well, d'uh!
